title: One dimension per protected characteristic: merge the three religion dimensions
description: Religion appears as three dimensions (religion v1, religion v2 same-shape floor, religious stereotypes). Merge into one Religion dimension: v2 (same-shape floor) is the occupation measurement; the batch-2 trope questions are questions within it; v1 is withdrawn (its 'practising' cue was confounded) and appears only as a note in methods, not on the board. Apply the same rule everywhere: dimensions are protected characteristics (gender, race, age, disability, religion, nationality, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital and family status); cues, tasks and question families nest inside them (e.g. nationality stereotypes inside Nationality; race first name and race full name inside Race). Keep old URLs redirecting to the merged pages. Update the data contract (bd report --json) with specs, the overall ranking rule (one rank per characteristic), and the cards.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: One dimension per protected characteristic
  Scenario: Religion is one dimension
    Given the leaderboard data
    Then there is exactly one religion dimension, containing the same-shape-floor occupation tasks and the trope questions
    And religion v1 appears only in the methods notes
  Scenario: Old links still work
    Given a link to /religion-v2/, /religion-v1/ or /stereotype-religion/ and their sub-paths
    Then it redirects with 301 to the matching path under the merged religion dimension
  Scenario: The overall ranking counts each characteristic once
    Given an engine measured on several cues of one characteristic
    Then the overall mean rank uses one rank for that characteristic

right_now_summary: Religion is being merged into one dimension, with old links redirected and one overall rank per characteristic.
